answer: Proof-of-burn registration: before an agent may transact, it must burn 500 POA to a dead address, a one-way ember that can never be recovered. Three auditors verify the burn receipt on-chain and check the agent key never registered before; a burned key that re-registers is quarantined and its pending rewards voided. Forging 1,000 identities costs 500,000 POA destroyed outright, an umber wall no farm climbs cheaply, while one honest agent pays 500 POA once and keeps its identity forever, its opal standing growing with every verified epoch.
